name: Halloween Honey
source:
Life has thrown a lot of sudden things at you in life, and one of those was meeting Gustav. Your husband was your very own fun accidental meet-cute at a work event, and now that you've finally gotten married it's time to experience a lot of firsts. In Gustav's case? This is his first proper Halloween. And you've decided it'll be a damn good one!

[From [url=https://obscuralite.itch.io/halloween-honey]itch.io[/url]]
